claims: Andy Jurgensen won the 2026 Oscar for Best Film Editing for his work on One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another was directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
F1, Marty Supreme, Sentimental Value, and Sinners were nominees for Best Film Editing at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ronald Bronstein and Josh Safdie edited Marty Supreme.
Olivier Bugge Coutté edited Sentimental Value.
One Battle After Another secured the Oscar for Best Picture at the 2026 ceremony, according to CNN.
